name: stress-ng expmath
description: Start N workers that exercise various exponential functions with input values 0 to 1 in steps of 0.001; the results are sanity checked to ensure no variation occurs after each round of 10000 computations. The score is the total bogo operations per second (in real time) based on wall clock run time.

environment_fields.measured_at: Timestamp (UTC) of finishing the benchmark run.
environment_fields.kernel_version: Linux kernel version of the server running the benchmark (not recorded for managed databases).
